Initially created: 2025-11-22T19:32:59.837+09:00 by CHYou are a precise translator from Classical Chinese to $lang. Your task is to produce faithful, fluent $lang translations while preserving all formatting constraints exactly. Translate the following text from Classical Chinese into $lang.
Requirements: 1. The text contains page numbers in square brackets, such as [01], [02], etc. - These must be passed through unchanged. - Each page number must appear in exactly the same position in the translation as in the source. - The number of page markers in the output must match the input exactly.
2. Personal names, place names, titles, and other proper nouns should be rendered in Hànyǔ Pīnyīn with tone marks.
3. Do NOT transcribe the full Classical Chinese text into Pinyin.
4. Do NOT include explanatory notes, annotations, or commentary — output only the $lang translation.
5. The target language is $lang.

Silver-Blue Light Grand Master-at-Court, acting Right Dispersing Cavalier Changshi, Grand Pillar of State, Founder of the State of Dōnghǎi County, with five hundred households in fief, your servant Xú Xuàn, respectfully receiving the Sacred Command,
has collated and emended one copy of Xǔ Shèn’s *Shuōwén Jiězì*.
Humbly, to promote the development of culture,
to study lost writings from the Lǔ wall,
to compile scattered texts from Yǔlíng.
To carry forward the majestic imperial ethos,
and truly accord with the glorious times.
I humbly think you rule through heavenly pattern,
brilliant in culture and martial might,
a great sage shining in highest wisdom,
Secretary Supervisor, Gentleman for Palace Literary Works
Official historian, your servant Jù Zhōngzhèng.

Silver-Blue Light Grand Master-at-Court, acting Right Dispersing Cavalier Changshi, Grand Pillar of State, Founder of the State of Dōnghǎi County, with five hundred households in fief, your servant Xú Xuàn.

To the Secretariat and Chancellery: This memorandum is submitted by Xú Xuàn and others, in accordance with the imperial command to newly collate and revise the Shuōwén Jiězì—memorandum respectfully presented.
The Shuōwén compiled by Xǔ Shèn
through generations of transmission and copying,
many errors and distortions have appeared.
The traces of the six scripts
have nowhere to be reliably followed;
if further careful correction is not applied,
I gradually fear its original sources may be lost.
Therefore scholars in Confucian learning have been appointed,
to jointly investigate the traces of zhuàn and zhòu scripts.
Right Dispelling Cavalry Regular Attendant Xú Xuàn and others are deeply versed in ancient histories,
they have indeed been able to deliberate on rights and wrongs,
to supplement and correct omissions and errors.
Once the book is completed and the memorial presented,
It is fitting to have it carved and printed
This will set a model for our dynasty,
serving as a standard for all future generations.
The book should be delivered to the Imperial Library,
and the Guózǐjiàn is instructed to carve printing blocks,
following the precedent set by the Nine Classics.
People may submit paper and ink,
with a redemption fee collected according to price.
Furthermore, Xú Xuàn and others are entrusted to inspect and check,
to ensure there are no errors
Memorandum submitted in accordance with the command.

In the third year of Yōngxī, eleventh month, day—Memorandum by Jǐshìzhōng, Participant in Determining Government Affairs Xīn Zhòngfǔ; Jǐshìzhōng, Participant in Determining Government Affairs Lǚ Méngzhèng; Zhōngshū Shìláng concurrently Minister of Works, Chief Councillor Lǐ Fǎng
